known_gaps.summary: Merged Copper lists execute, but mid-scanline palette/bitplane changes, sprite composition, and blitter line-mode DMA remain incomplete and can affect later frames.

The corrected 171-event corpus reaches menus and substantive gameplay through 9,112 PAL frames, but it remains one observed path; additional map, minigame, disk-2, and timing-stress scenarios require independent semantic recordings.

Generated execution covers only the fail-closed M68000 subset proven by resident recovery; speculative relocation targets, unresolved indirect transfers, and modified code remain explicit fallback/frontier work.

Resident function boundaries and sampled instruction costs are evidence-backed, but M68000 register/stack/flag ABI effects remain explicitly underived and incomplete calls are excluded from cost histograms.
Observed LoadSeg generations receive exact file, relocation, and relocated-range identities, but Atlas control-flow identities are not yet generation-scoped and unobserved overlay loads remain open.

fallback.notes: Only the validated conservative M68000 subset executes as generated hooks; all other or modified instructions retain explicit observable interpreter/SMC fallback.

port.reason: No complete PortForge-independent source port exists.

play.description: Open the default oracle player, or explicitly select the verified generated+fallback runtime; headless execution uses explicit role plans and the shared Amiga replay adapter.

replay.description: Replay the bound ArtifactV2 corpus through ReplaySession and require exact semantic-boundary checkpoints, continuation restore, canonical audio, and complete event consumption.

analyze.description: Verify the pinned ADF set and bound EvidenceV3, recover resident M68000 instructions and blocks, and materialize a deterministic pf-recovered-blocks-v1 Atlas source.

build-generated.description: Regenerate byte-guarded M68000 hooks, build both generated runners, and require ArtifactV2 terminal equality under explicit oracle and generated execution plans.

play-generated.description: Run the verified generated subset with observable interpreter and self-modifying-code fallback.

atlas.description: Recollect bound EvidenceV3, regenerate recovered blocks, and atomically rebuild disposable Atlas v2 indexes without executing or verifying replay inside Atlas.

semantic.description: Regenerate resident Amiga machine-function boundaries, partial ABI cards, sampled instruction-cost profiles, and provenance-bound context dossiers from EvidenceV3.

frontier.description: Rank the highest-value unreplaced Amiga machine functions using static CFG, replay calls, measured cost, Atlas occurrence, and risk evidence.
